_comment: The relationship lines — the Winston guide's General & Relationship section, in Viva's voice. {name_part} is either an empty string or ', <FirstName>', derived deterministically from the vault's own account holders.
welcome_empty: Welcome{name_part}. I'm Viva — I'm here to help you organize your financial world. The best way to start is a single, simple step: add one statement below, and I'll show you what I can do.
welcome_back: Welcome back{name_part}. It's good to see you. We can continue right where we left off, whenever you're ready.
reassurance: We proceed entirely at your pace{name_part}. If you'd rather attend to other matters, you can always come back and we will continue exactly where we left off.
not_now_ack: Of course{name_part}. I've set it aside, and I won't raise it again unless something new arrives.
dont_know_ack: Not a problem at all{name_part} — it isn't essential, and we can add it later if you come across it. Moving on.
all_settled: Nothing right now{name_part}. Everything I can settle, I have.
